title: Room-Temperature Superconductivity
description: Cooper pairs that hold together at room temperature, inside a hydrogen-rich framework.

puzzle.goal: Electrons near the Fermi surface attract each other through lattice vibrations, but only within the Debye energy ħωD of it, with dimensionless coupling λ. At the critical temperature the pairing gap just vanishes, and the self-consistency condition reduces to an integral over the electron energy ξ weighted by the thermal occupation factor. Write that condition.
puzzle.name: BCS gap equation at the critical temperature
puzzle.form: λ * int ( 0 , ħ * ω _ D , tanh ( ξ / ( 2 * kB * Tc ) ) / ξ , ξ )
puzzle.ask: For weak coupling the integral gives kB Tc = 1.13 ħωD e^(−1/λ). Find Tc (K) for a hydride with Debye temperature Θ = ħωD/kB = 1800 K and λ = @{λ}.

vars.\u03be: electron energy from the Fermi level

puzzle.method: Set the gap to zero in the self-consistent gap equation; the thermal factor 1 − 2f(ξ) becomes tanh(ξ/2kBT). For λ ≪ 1 the integral is ≈ ln(1.13ħωD/kBTc).
